description: Report what a YAML reader will do with the text supplied, as distinct from whether the data is correct. Reports a duplicate key, which most readers accept while silently keeping the last; an unquoted YAML 1.1 boolean word such as on, off, yes or no, which arrives as a boolean rather than text; a leading zero read as octal; and a two-part version read as a float, where a patch number would change the type. Anchors and merge keys are refused with the line. Pay 120000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

yaml.description: The text to read. YAML, read as a documented subset: block mappings and sequences, flow collections of scalars, block scalars, and multiple documents separated by ---. Anchors, aliases, merge keys and explicit tags are refused with the line rather than half parsed. Nothing is fetched: no cluster, registry or repository is contacted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.
yaml.example:
country: NO
mode: 0644
version: 1.0
enabled: on
title: ""
retries: 3
retries: 5
off: later

name: yaml_document_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

valid.description: True only when the source parsed and nothing in it will surprise a reader.
